name: streaming-text
description: Reveals text character by character with a blinking cursor, catching up as a streamed reply grows

meta.name: StreamingText
meta.description: Reveals text character by character with a blinking cursor, catching up as a streamed reply grows

props.name: text
props.description: The target text. Pass the accumulating reply as it streams; typing catches up as it grows, and restarts if it is replaced by a shorter string.

props.name: onComplete
props.description: Called when the displayed text has caught up with `text`.

whenToUse: Rendering an assistant reply as it streams in, smoothing bursty token arrival into steady typing
whenNotToUse: Announcing the reply to screen readers — StreamingText is never a live region; announce completion with announce() or AiStatus

antiPatterns.good: Leave it silent and announce the finished reply once
antiPatterns.why: A live region around typing text announces fragments on every frame

related.name: AiStatus
related.reason: AiStatus announces the phase while StreamingText renders the words

related.name: TypingIndicator
related.reason: Before the first token arrives, show TypingIndicator instead

intent.a11yRationale: Plain text, never a live region, so a screen reader reads it on demand rather than being fed every character; the cursor is aria-hidden and blinks only under prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference

flexibility.note: Do not add aria-live; announce completion separately
